title: Slight reduction of heparin dose for the treatment of deep vein thrombosis during pregnancy
official: Randomized trial for the definition of the optimal regimen of heparin for the treatment of deep vein thrombosis during pregnancy
summary: Primary objective: to demonstrate that reduced-dose LMWH is non-inferior to full therapeutic-dose LMWH in preventing symptomatic recurrent VTE after an initial six-week period of therapeutic treatment in pregnant women with a first episode of proximal lower-limb DVT.

interventions.name: Enoxaparina Ledraxen 8000 UI (80 mg)/0,8 mL soluzione iniettabile in siringa preriempita

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. First Proximal DVT of the leg occurred between 5th and 30th gestational weeks
2. Women of all ethnicities
3. ≥ 18 years old	 4. Signature of informed consent
4. Signature of informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Inability or unwillingness to provide written informed consent
2. Participation in another interventional clinical trial.
3. Active clinically relevant bleeding
4. Severe thrombocytopenia (<50 × 10⁹/L).
5. History of confirmed or strongly suspected heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT).
6. Absolute contraindication to anticoagulation or LMWH, including hypersensitivity
7. Severe renal impairment (eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m²) or renal dysfunction incompatible with LMWH treatment
8. Active malignancy or malignancy requiring chemotherapy/radiotherapy
9. Immediately life-threatening clinical condition
10. Pulmonary embolism at presentation
11. Severe thrombophilia, as defined in the protocol.
12. Acute/active chronic disease that may interfere with the study
13. Presence of an inferior vena cava filter
14. Conditions requiring long-term anticoagulation independently of the index DVT
15. Severe cardiorespiratory impairment (NYHA III–IV).
